{{Quote|Subject extremely hateful and unruly. Also known as "The Kip."|Kip Bunyea's bounty brief|<ref name="BH" />}}
'''Kip Bunyea''', or "'''The Kip'''," was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] with affiliations to data [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. A [[Death/Legends|dead]]-or-alive [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on him was posted by [[Aruk Besadii Aora|Aruk]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] no later than [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he spent [[Time/Legends|time]] at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] pursuit of [[drug dealer]] [[Jervis Gloom]].

==Biography==
Kip Bunyea, also known as "The Kip," was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="BH" /> who hailed from<ref name="Prima" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. He<ref name="Prima" /> was affiliated with narcotic [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and data [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]].<ref name="BH" /> By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] criminal [[Aruk Besadii Aora]]<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> had issued a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] for him. It stated Bunyea's last known location was the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and described him as extremely hateful and unruly. The bounty also offered a price of 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for him alive or 1,000 for his [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="BH" />

In 32 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]], Bunyea spent [[Time/Legends|time]] at<ref name="BH" /> the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]], a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of<ref name="CSWE22">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> the Core Worlds planet<ref name="CL" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE22" /> He stood at the club's bar when [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] entered during his pursuit of [[Death stick/Legends|death stick]] [[Drug dealer|dealer]] [[Jervis Gloom]]. The man remained there while Fett threatened the [[Bufon Taire/Legends|bartender]] and dispatched several thugs.<ref name="BH" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Bunyea was identified as a bounty by Fett and was captured as<ref name="BH" /> he cowered pathetically<ref name="Prima" /> at the bar.<ref name="BH" /> 
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
The man had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin. He was thought of as a hateful and unruly individual.<ref name="BH" />

==Equipment==
Bunyea wore a black and white [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] while at the Outlander.<ref name="BH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kip Bunyea first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', developed by [[LucasArts]] and released in [[2002]].<ref name="BH" /> The character, who can be either captured alive or killed for differing sums of credits, is the fourteenth bounty in the Coruscant Entertainment District and the thirty-ninth bounty overall.<ref name="Prima" /> Bunyea shares his name with [[Kip Bunyea (lead tester)|Kip Bunyea]], a real-world lead game tester for LucasArts,<ref>{{LinkedIn|url=in/kipbunyea|text=Kip Bunyea|archivefile=File:Kip_Bunyea_LinkedIn.png}}</ref> and his character model is similar to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' character [[BoShek/Legends|BoShek]].<ref name="BoShek">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Power of the Jedi|pack=BoShek|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/POTJboshek.asp}}</ref>
